unit_label: BRBL::MOD_C::U10: Apply rectification relief without prejudicing intervening rights

facts.statement: Section26A permits extension/rectification on specified accident/inadvertence/sufficient-cause or just-equitable grounds, terms/conditions; extension cannot prejudice rights acquired before actual registration.

payload.title: Correcting the record does not erase earlier third-party rights
payload.core_explanation_md:
Section26A provides a route to address the stated filing omissions or misstatements. The Central Government must be satisfied of the relevant statutory grounds, such as accident, inadvertence, sufficient cause or the just-and-equitable basis, and may impose terms. It is not a private self-certification that every late filing is harmless.

Where time is extended, rights acquired in the property or financial asset before actual registration are protected by the stated limitation on relief. Keep evidence of the omission, relief application, order and actual registration separate from an intervening third party claim. A corrected spelling and a retroactive priority assertion are different issues.

self_check.prompt_text: Does permission to file late necessarily destroy intervening third-party rights?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The provision preserves the stated earlier-acquired rights.

payload.stem_md: A lender obtains an extension for late registration and assumes that every right acquired before actual filing disappears. Which section 26A condition prevents that shortcut?

options.text_md: Every extension is unlimited and unconditional
options.explanation_md: The provision permits terms and contains express limits.

options.text_md: An extension is always the same as full satisfaction
options.explanation_md: Time relief does not repay or discharge a claim.

options.text_md: Relief must not prejudice the specified rights acquired before actual registration
options.explanation_md: Actual filing and intervening rights remain legally significant.

options.text_md: A private lender email is enough to grant governmental relief
options.explanation_md: The applicable authority and order are required.

payload.correct_explanation_md: Actual filing and intervening rights remain legally significant.

payload.stem_md: A filing contains an accidental material misstatement. Which record best supports the rectification route?

options.text_md: The error evidence, statutory grounds, application and authority order
options.explanation_md: The relief depends on the relevant grounds and decision, not only a desired outcome.

options.text_md: An instruction to delete the original record without history
options.explanation_md: Unrecorded deletion does not establish lawful rectification.

options.text_md: A promise that no other creditor exists
options.explanation_md: The promise is not a substitute for examining affected rights.

options.text_md: A backdated filing time chosen by staff
options.explanation_md: Staff cannot invent an operative timestamp to create priority.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The relief depends on the relevant grounds and decision, not only a desired outcome.
